examples.title: AFNI-45: -T2up 100 reads past the sorted values
examples.summary: With -T2, 3dUnifize inverts the contrast about an upper percentile of the masked values (-T2up, 98.5 by default, 90 to 100 allowed). At 100 the percentile's index is one past the end of the sorted values. fMRIPrep's call with -T2up 100 added, given to AFNI 25.2.09 and to the replica in both modes, beside fMRIPrep's own call.

facts.label: Input
facts.text: the masked BOLD reference of the first example

facts.label: Defect
facts.text: [AFNI-45](repo:docs/findings/upstream-defects.md#afni-45---t2up-near-100-reads-past-the-sorted-values--a): -T2up near 100 reads past the sorted values; corrected by default, with a warning

grid.orientation: RAS (shown in neurological convention: the subject's left on the left)

diffs.label: replica (default) − AFNI, -T2up 100
diffs.reason: AFNI-45, corrected by default with a warning: at -T2up 100 the percentile's index falls one past the sorted values, where AFNI reads memory it never wrote (here 0: every value inverts to 0, and so does the output); the default inverts about the largest value, the 100th percentile. Reproduce mode fills that read with 0.

diffs.label: replica (reproduce) − AFNI, -T2up 100
diffs.reason: reproduce mode gives AFNI's result: the read past the end filled with 0, as AFNI read it on this machine.
